evidence: The current HBNF controller calls a Supabase Edge Function on a separate origin; the active backend has no Guest Mode state, guest session endpoints, or guest-action endpoint.
The existing device-session validator shares credentials with the broad command route and therefore cannot safely be repurposed as a guest session boundary.
The checked-out React application is Local Roots, not the HBNF Cart origin; using its /guest route would serve the feature from the wrong product origin.

The repository has no configured HBNF same-origin Pages Functions route/build entrypoint. Supabase Edge Function paths are project/functions/v1/name and do not by themselves provide the requested Cart-origin /guest/{cartId} and /api/cart/... paths.

The authoritative current source does not specify how owner override is atomically checked/serialized against a guest write. Guessing a route host or trust boundary could grant guest access to owner/device commands.
blocker.required_owner_input: Identify/authorize the existing HBNF same-origin host/build entrypoint for /guest/{cartId} and its API routes, and identify the existing owner-override/serialized-dispatch interface Guest V1 must call. This is interface/source authority, not a visual preference.
